design.concept: A calm reference list for a manager on a phone. The team list opens first, with a quiet name search on top and a thumb-reachable "Nova pessoa" button at the foot. Tapping a person, or the new-person button, opens a single full-width record view with a back control, one field per line and the save button pinned at the bottom.

views.purpose: Reading surface: search by name, list of people with name, status and country, load more, and the entry point to register someone new. Tapping a row opens that person's record.

One view for both tasks: empty for a new person (register) or filled for the selected person (correct name and country). It has back, read-only facts (status, roles, contacts), a failure message above the button and the save button at the thumb.

design.decisions: Both views live inside the ml-scenary host so back navigation and the visible scene are owned by the shared scenary state. One record view serves register and edit, chosen by whether a person is selected, to keep the phone flow short. Plain inputs and buttons are used with large touch targets; the save and new-person actions sit at the bottom of the screen for thumb reach.
